verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents first-party escalation policies that send alert notifications to on-call schedules or individual users. Alerts can be acknowledged, and Slack channels can be notified directly. However, the evidence never describes the stepwise mechanics the story centres on. Missing for 10: documented multi-step escalation chains with per-step delays, fallback responders when a step goes unanswered, repeat/loop rounds until acknowledgment, acknowledgment-gated progression, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
